The '''Zona Miki route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that reached the [[Zona Miki system/Legends|Zona Miki system]].

==History==
By [[1750 BBY]], the new [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] leader [[Dark Underlord]] assailed the [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] along the Zona Miki route with his [[Black Knights]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fought back by hiring [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who helped the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to [[Battle of Malrev IV|defeat]] Dark Underlord on [[Malrev IV]].
